what_this_is: DATA for do-work/check-a-branch.mjs, the branch mode of tool:check-against-a-persons-rules-and-verdicts: where a person's branches and checks are in their records. `method_type`: the record type of their method rows (list:methods; each { id, extends?, check_lists?, judge_settings? }). `check_type`: the record type of their one Checks list (list:checks), read with the door's `where` on `branch_field` once per branch of the lineage, never whole. `list_type`: the record type of a list (`list:<id>`, its `row_type` names its rows' type `record:<row_type>`), read for each list a branch names in `check_lists`. `check_list_row_types`: the row types such a list may have; the row's rights list each one, and a list of any other row type is refused. A row with `step_field` is a question of a decision step, asked by tools/decide-with-a-method and never judged here; a row whose `on_field` is `off` is not judged. `words`: every refusal and note of the branch mode, {name} filled from the request. A row that states no test (none of tools/judge-words SELECTOR_NAMES, imported, never listed here), has no `ask_field` and no `part_field`, or whose `kind_field` is `piece_kind` (a piece of a source file, do-work/pieces.mjs), is never judged: it is counted in rows_used.skipped.no_test and listed for a model to read in read_by_a_model, at most `read_by_a_model_at_most` rows (`more` counts the rest). A branch whose rows are all such rows answers status `no_applicable_status` with the line `words.no_applicable_rule`.

words.rules_and_branch: Send a branch or rules and verdict_rules, not both: with branch the rules are read from the person's own check rows.
words.branch: branch must be the id of one of the person's method rows (list:methods), such as the kind of thing being checked.
words.no_methods: The person has no method rows (list:methods); a branch is one of them.
words.no_rules: The branch {branch} (lineage {lineage}) has no check rows to judge with outside its verdict rows: {used}. Add a check row with method set to one of its branches, or send rules.
words.check_list_missing: The method {method} names the check list {list}, which is not in the person's records; fix its check_lists.
words.check_list_row_type: The method {method} names the check list {list}, whose rows are {row_type}; this tool may read only {allowed}. Add the row type to read-data/branch.json and the row's rights, or move those rows into list:checks.
words.no_applicable_rule: The branch {branch} (lineage {lineage}) has no row that states a test: its {count} rows are listed in read_by_a_model for a model to read. Give a row words, pattern, exact, check, groups, path, evidence, ask or part to judge with it.
